source.edition: First Edition 2018; Revised Edition 2019, 2020 (Published under New Syllabus); 2026-27 reprint year not verified

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/tn-g11.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://cdn1.byjus.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/TN-Board-Class-11-Mathematics-Vol-1-Textbook.pdf https://11thstudymaterials.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/11th-maths-volume-1-new-school-books-download-english-medium.pdf https://cdn1.byjus.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/TN-Board-Class-11-Mathematics-Vol-2-Textbook.pdf https://news.careers360.com/tamil-nadu-government-order-cancel-class-11th-public-exams-from-2025-26-onwards-higher-secondary-certificates-have-12th-marks/amp. Notes: Official sites textbooksonline.tn.nic.in and textbookcorp.tn.gov.in could not be read: WebFetch was refused by their robots.txt, and the shell has no internet access. dge.tn.gov.in and tnschools.gov.in were not reached either. The chapter and section titles were therefore taken from copies of the official SCERT/Government of Tamil Nadu textbook PDFs hosted on cdn1.byjus.com (and, for Grade 11 Vol I, on 11thstudymaterials.wordpress.com). These are mirrors of the government PDF (cover 'GOVERNMENT OF TAMIL NADU', '(c) SCERT', 'A publication under Free Textbook Programme') and were used only because the official host was unreachable. Section titles are the top-level numbered sections from each volume's contents page, as reported by the fetch tool. Capitalisation follows the printed contents, which is inconsistent in the book itself. The fetched PDF text had OCR/ligature artefacts (e.g. 'Th eorem'), so small punctuation or capitalisation differences are possible. Sub-sections (e.g. 1.2.1) are omitted because they could not be seen for every chapter. Edition for 2026-27: the books in use are still the 'Published under New Syllabus' set (first edition 2018 for Std XI, 2019 for Std XII, with later revised editions). Ne
